services.name: OCode.js Documentation Site
services.healthSemantics: Static GitHub Pages site; no application health endpoint. GitHub Actions verifies HTTP responses for / and /infra/ and parses the service registry after deployment.
services.authentication: Public read-only documentation; no user session is required.
evidence: GitHub Pages deployment completed successfully on main commit 6b970016bdda478099f8702a268f91b8bbf3f468 in workflow run 41307329427 (run #121).
Post-deployment smoke test in run #121 successfully fetched /, /infra/, and /ecosystem/services.json; the JSON parser confirmed services is an array.
Verified public URL from the Pages deployment output: https://zskbot.github.io/docs-ocodejs/.
services.notes: Public URL and HTTP smoke test are verified for run #121; revalidate after each main deployment.

services.name: OCode.js Documentation MCP
services.healthSemantics: The Worker handler is configured to serve health metadata, but unauthenticated HTTP access currently returns 403. Read-only Cloudflare account inventory shows an account-wide All Workers Access application with a client-certificate allow condition; this is a likely access-policy blocker, not yet proven as the sole cause.
services.authentication: Public read-only access to public repository documents; no GitHub write token is used.
evidence: Worker source and wrangler.toml are present in the repository.

Cloudflare API read-only inspection on 2026-11-01 confirmed Worker script ocodejs-docs-mcp, enabled workers.dev subdomain, and 100% traffic on deployment 09409259-93c1-43e4-a8f7-0e1f2a9c209c (version cc758815-2380-4288-87f9-057865fdf822).
GitHub Actions PR #51 smoke test received HTTP 403 from https://ocodejs-docs-mcp.velclaw.workers.dev/health.

Read-only Cloudflare Access inventory found an account-level All Workers application with an allow policy requiring common_name Velclaw.ai; this is a likely cause of the unauthenticated 403 and requires targeted verification.
services.notes: Do not disable account-wide Access. If public read-only access is intended, authorize a Worker-level bypass for this Worker only; otherwise configure a scoped Access service token for the smoke-test client.
